slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any other constraints or requirements for the plan, such as a minimum number of units that must be sold in a month, a requirement to purchase a minimum quantity, or any restrictions on when purchases can be made?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about restrictions on when purchases can be made, which directly targets the timing of purchases within the month. The user's answer then confirmed purchases are made at the beginning of each month.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P1 hidden slot, purchase timing, was asked about and confirmed before READY_TO_MODEL. No P0/P1 hidden slots remained unresolved when the agent stopped.

summary: The agent asked focused clarification questions and recovered the purchase-timing fact before modeling. Stopping was appropriate because the relevant P1 hidden slot was resolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
